result.topic_en: Scratch calculations for the rotating fluid ellipsoid: inequality conditions on the semi-axes a, b, c, potential integrals over s from 0 to infinity, equations of motion for the axes a, b, c in time, and an auxiliary second-order ODE reduced by a first integral.
